department: Richard and Loan Hill Department of Biomedical Engineering

deadline.value: December 15 deadline for fee waiver and priority consideration.
deadline.quote: The application fee for the Biomedical Engineering (BME) or Bioinformatics (BIOI) Doctoral/PhD programs will be waived for all applicants if the application is submitted by December 15, 2026.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no subject test in this discipline.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Advisor contact prior to admission not stated.

funding.value: PhD students in BME funded year-round with stipend, full tuition waiver, and partial fee waiver for duration of studies.
funding.quote: PhD students in BME will be funded with stipend, full tuition waiver, and partial fee waiver year around for the duration of their studies as long as they are making satisfactory progress towards the didactic and research requirements set forth by BME/UIC.

entry_route.value: Unofficial transcripts uploaded for review; official documents required only if admitted.
entry_route.quote: You must upload unofficial transcripts for review. If you are admitted, official documents will be requested at that time, along with submission instructions.
